format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-badge id="bd-old" text="Старые имена" type="outline" status="danger" icon-left="check"></sf-badge>

probes.title: draws its text on the appearance, colour and size classes

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#bd .sf-badge'); return b.textContent.trim() === 'Новый' && b.classList.contains('sf-badge--main') && b.classList.contains('sf-badge--primary') && b.classList.contains('sf-badge--size-1/3'); })()

probes.title: a status paints instead of the colour role

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#bd-status .sf-badge'); return b.classList.contains('sf-badge--success') && b.classList.contains('sf-badge--tonal'); })()

probes.title: type, danger and icon-left still draw, each noted with its dates

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#bd-old .sf-badge'); return b.classList.contains('sf-badge--outline') && b.classList.contains('sf-badge--error') && b.querySelector('.sf-icon')?.textContent.trim() === 'check'; })()

probes.title: a status word written as scheme reaches status
aria-label is said through a hidden span, the visible text hidden

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#bd-label .sf-badge'); return b.querySelector('.sr-only')?.textContent === 'Больше 99 новых' && b.querySelector('.sf-badge-text-container').getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true'; })()

probes.title: an empty icon-start suppresses the icon shortcut; nothing to say is aria-hidden
